To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IT infrastructure flexibility and assimilation are both important to supply chain agility and performance, but the mediating effects are different.
IT infrastructure flexibility can increase the firm’s supply agility, and IT assimilation can improve the firm's absorptive capacity.

IT infrastructure flexibility and the firm's absorptive capacity are positively related to the firm's IT assimilation, and that the firm's supply chain agility and the firm's IT infrastructure flexibility are positively related to supply chain performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of a firms’ IT capabilities, supply chain agility and its absorptive capacity on its supply chain performance.
the mechanisms of IT capabilities’ influence on supply chain performance.
the effects of IT capabilities on the supply chain performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IT infrastructure flexibility can enhance IT assimilation, which can further enhance supply chain agility and supply chain performance.
IT infrastructure flexibility can help firms to improve IT assimilation and supply chain agility, while IT assimilation can help firms to enhance supply chain agility and supply chain performance.
IT infrastructure flexibility can help firms improve supply chain agility and IT assimilation, and in turn, supply chain agility can help firms to improve supply chain performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a model to explain how a firm can improve its supply chain performance through IT capabilities and the mediating effects by its higher-order organizational capabilities.
the firm’s IT capabilities and higher-order organizational capabilities can jointly improve the firm’s supply performance.

IT capabilities can be leveraged to improve supply chain performance through the mediating effects on the firm’s higher-level dynamic capabilities, i.e. supply chain agility and supply chain absorptive capacity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
firms can enhance supply chain performance through IT capabilities, which is achieved through supply chain agility and the firm’s absorptive capacity.
IT capabilities can be transformed into supply chain agility and then to supply chain performance, and IT assimilation can be improved by IT infrastructure flexibility.
the firm’s higher order dynamic capabilities are critical in mediating IT capability’s influence on supply chain performance.
